description: This file defines the ExampleStorageAttributeMapper class which implements the IAttributeToFactoryMapper interface for mapping ExampleStorageAttribute to a factory method. It interacts with dependency injection and reflection to create storage factory instances based on attributes and parameter info.

classes.name: ExampleStorageAttributeMapper
classes.description: Implements IAttributeToFactoryMapper for ExampleStorageAttribute, mapping attributes to factory functions that create storage objects based on configuration and context.

methods.name: GetFactory
methods.description: Returns a factory function based on the Attribute and parameter information, handling default value settings and generic method invocation.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Invokes the storage factory method via reflection, using the context and factory method info.
